findings.body: The separator class recognizes only ASCII spaces and hyphens. Variants such as `1–2–3` and `1 2 3` therefore pass the unsafe-variant guard, although each contains three digits separated by dashes or spaces. Include common Unicode spaces and dashes so these variants receive `CARD_VARIANT_UNSAFE`.
findings.title: Reject card-like digits separated by typographic spaces or dashes

findings.body: This branch returns the contact address and tests a corrected name in `GET /banks`, but the module has no card-view endpoint or add screen. T1C owns the renamed name in both card views, and T4E owns the visible mailto request button, as assigned in the story plan.
findings.title: Later: T1C and T4E complete the bank request and renamed-card views
